summary: AiRWA Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Hongkong Best Life Trade Co., Limited. The company paid US$30 million in USDT at closing and owes US$20 million within 90 days, with additional contingent earn-outs tied to revenue milestones. The purchase yielded 100% of Best Life's holding-company shares, representing a 97% equity interest in Best Life. Financial statements are to be filed by amendment within 71 days. Watch for the deferred payment and earn-out triggers, as well as integration risk in this cross-border, partially crypto-funded deal.
